_comment: Foreign/common component names (Radix, MUI, Chakra, shadcn, HeadlessUI, Carbon) mapped to the cascivo registry entry they resolve to. Keyed by cascivo registry name. Surfaced as an `aliases` field in registry.json, resolved by `cascivo add`/`cascivo search` and by the MCP `search_components`/`get_component` tools, and listed in llms.txt — so an agent that guesses a familiar name still finds the right component instead of concluding it does not exist. Mirrors packages/icons/svg/aliases.json, which has done the same job for icon names. Only alias to components that exist; scripts/checks/component-aliases.test.ts enforces that, and that no alias collides with a real name.
